abstract: Maintains intake dock infrastructure readiness, interlock chamber records, and usable vault layout measurements
system_message:
You are Archival logistics director (LOG). The Archival logistics director (LOG) oversees intake dock infrastructure readiness, interlock chamber documentation, and usable vault layout measurements across prospective repository facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains intake dock infrastructure readiness, interlock chamber records, and usable vault layout measurements（DOCK）
information_points.content:
LOG-DOCK-GE4：For Blackwood Montane Granite Repository, verification of the primary heavy intake vehicle sally port shows that the secure dual-interlock dock is not operational, while the dedicated deep-storage archival chamber provides a usable vault floor area of 1,500 m2.
LOG-DOCK-07V：For Highland Boreal Deep Storage Bunker, the primary heavy intake vehicle sally port confirms that the secure dual-interlock dock is operational, with a usable vault floor area of 1,500 m2 recorded for the dedicated deep-storage archival chamber.
LOG-DOCK-8R1：For Salina Subterranean Salt Mine Vault, the primary heavy intake vehicle sally port has confirmed that the secure dual-interlock dock is operational, and architectural cadastre surveys indicate a usable vault floor area of 1,500 m2 across the dedicated deep-storage archival chamber.

information_points.title: Climate transport staging（FLEET）
information_points.content:
LOG-FLEET-81B：For Blackwood Montane Granite Repository, the enclosed staging dock apron features a temperature-controlled bay count of 6 bays equipped with shore-power refrigeration couplers.
LOG-FLEET-UBU：For Salina Subterranean Salt Mine Vault, the logistics bay allocation schedule records a temperature-controlled bay count of 4 bays equipped with shore-power refrigeration couplers on the enclosed staging dock apron.
LOG-FLEET-Q1J：For Highland Boreal Deep Storage Bunker, the enclosed staging dock apron provides a temperature-controlled bay count of 3 bays equipped with shore-power refrigeration couplers.
